Based on the retrieved excerpts, the sub-clause that requires assessing OH&S opportunities to enhance safety performance is **clause 6.1.2.3**.

This clause explicitly states that "The organization must establish processes to assess OH&S opportunities to enhance OH&S performance" and goes on to specify that this includes accounting for:
- Planned changes to the organization, its policies, processes or activities
- Possibilities to adapt work, work organization and the working environment to workers
- Possibilities to eliminate hazards and reduce OH&S risks
- Other opportunities for improving the OH&S management system
